title: Rate limit failed logins
body:
## Summary

After 5 failed logins for an email, further attempts return 429 for 15 minutes.

## Changes

* New rate limiter in core
* login checks and records failures

## How to test

Fail login 5 times then try the correct password.

verixa_should_cover: Fifth failure locks the account and returns 429
Correct password during lock is still refused
Counter should reset after a successful login (BUG: it never resets)
Lock is per email, so an attacker can lock out a real user
Unknown email is counted the same way
